steps.text: I saw two children fight over a fruit in that blurry mist.
They were about the same age and size, but one was quicker and punched heavier, and he knocked his foe to the ground.
He gets the fruit.
To the victor goes the spoils.
I saw that hunt.
Humanity declared war on Them. Mortals brought down gods that they could not even fathom, at the price of millions of lives.
Victory or death.

a.text: What is the meaning of kung fu?
Strength? Skill? An instrument of killing?
One man, no matter how strong, can never overcome an entire army or a battleship.
Is assassination and backstabbing a kind of skill? Why pick one's means of killing? Why study it as a school?
Searching for an answer before this obstacle, I forsook my power, sealed 'myself' into a sword, and built myself a human body.
How long has it been?
How long has it been since the last time I encountered an opponent against whom I could give my all?

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Round 8.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: The Grandmaster takes one step back before his opponent's assault. Huai Tianpei's fists are exhausted by the time they reach the Grandmaster's palm.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: (Flexes bones)

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Huff...

a.text: For forty years I have studied kung fu. I have never seen a mountain I could not overcome, never known defeat.
My first shifu told me he had nothing left to teach me after six months.
Each subsequent shifu that I studied under sent me away after a year, at most.
There are hundreds of kung fu schools under Heaven, but what use are so many moves, when you only have one pair of hands, one pair of feet?
I will practice my own kung fu.
Heavier. Faster. More precise.
But this man before me...

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Round 9...

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Huai Tianpei strikes at the Grandmaster's flank, cutting off his retreat.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: The Grandmaster stays still and strikes back with equal force, cutting off Huai Tianpei's attack.

a.text: The outcome is already clear... who could take nine hits from this man?
If he is a rock, then he is not facing a bigger rock, but a deep pool.
A pool with many rocks at its bottom.
How can one defeat Kung Fu itself?
But he is still standing.
Huai Tianpei digs deep into the sand, focusing his mind and breath, breathing out, breathing in.
Then, he holds up his fists again.
Move a mountain to fill a lake. If the pond cannot be filled, it only means that the rock is not big enough.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: (Coughs blood)
I lost.
I lost?

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Round... 10.
The Record Keeper's ink brush stops.
He does not know how to record this.
It could not be simpler. Punch, hit, separate. No forms, no variations, just force against force, like two children fighting over food.
The only difference is that they are fighting over victory.
He has never seen Grandmaster wince in pain. Until now.
Wind.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: ...The Grandmaster has won.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: (Coughs blood)

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Hahaha!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Hahahahaha!

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Looks like you weren't concerned with victory or defeat.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: How could I not be?!

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: You're the First Under Heaven.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: But all it took was forty years for me to get the upper hand on you, once. Another three hundred and sixty years, and I'll beat you and become First Under Heaven!

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: True, you would likely surpass me, if you had another three hundred years.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But how can a mortal live that long?

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: It's true that some people have lived three centuries, using Originium Arts to extend their lifespans.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: I doubt that would be possible for Mr. Huai, however.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're the First Among Men. No need to wait three hundred years.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Grandmaster... Mr. Huai has fainted.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Take him back to the barracks. Treat his injuries.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: (Cheering)

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: (Bangs on sheathes)

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Liang Xun, that man is your friend?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Do you think he can be entrusted with the sword?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: In terms of skill and character, there is no other choice.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: What say you, Lord Exorcist?
Zuo Xuanliao says nothing. He gazes at the battlefield below. One lies on the ground, one is standing. The outcome has been decided.
But the soldiers continue to bang their swords on their sheathes, a tradition among Yumen soldiers when they watch a demonstration.
It was a rare sight, a life and death struggle on a great battlefield, under the raging winds and sand.
Even the sickly general feels his heart race.
How many times has he fought alongside him? Has he ever fought so hard against any other foe?
If there is one to whom he can entrust the sword, it should be...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: The Catastrophe...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: It's coming.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'm back, Shifu.
Jieyun limps towards a small mound by the nomadic city's route.
The grave is new, with a few poplars on each side that she planted to mark the place. Fortunately, it is close to where she thought it would be; the city has not traveled far.
She bows down and places the sword at the grave.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I said I would bring the sword back. I did it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I went to the forge, saw the blacksmith, and the old pagoda tree.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The city is very different from how I imagined.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Is that a place that can be called 'home?'
Why are people not afraid to live on a great, moving plate?
They're not afraid that a Catastrophe would destroy their houses, not afraid that they won't have food or water.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't understand the people in the city, or you, who left the city.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't understand what kind of person he is.

a.text: He is brave, strong, invincible.
He is foolish, pathetic, alienated.
You held his sword. You were close to him.

steps.text: The voice feels far away. Is someone speaking to her?
She suddenly wants to see what the sword is like.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'm leaving tomorrow.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The borders have been peaceful lately. Things should be fine even if I'm away for a while.
Such a hurry?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Your condition... and that of some of the others, they can't wait.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Just because there's no doctor who can treat it doesn't mean there's no one in Yan. If there's no one in Yan, perhaps there's another in these vast lands...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I have a brother who may be able to do it.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Take care while I'm away.
You're not a doctor. Why don't you ask what the patient wants?
My days may be numbered, but I want to see other places with the ones I have left.
All I've seen in my years at Yumen is sand as far as the eye could see. I want to travel, while I can still ride a burdenbeast.
To see Shangshu's famous mountains, taste Jiangnan's famous fresh water chestnuts...
With someone, hopefully.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're sick. You need to stay put...
What do you know about being sick? You've never been sick or injured, have you?
Not only that, we've known each other for so long, but I've never seen a crease appear on your face.
We're not the same.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'll be leaving. Don't think too much. Get some rest...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Is this a dream?

a.text: She draws the sword.

steps.text: The ancient sword leaves its sheath.
Its shape is somewhat unusual, but otherwise it is an ordinary sword, not even sharp.
Through the blade, she sees the clouds in the sky, and the shadow of the sun.

a.text: So this is how you separated yourself from It.
So obvious it was hardly worth thinking about.
You are the one who became most like Man.

steps.text: The sliver of the ghost leaves quietly.
He has found the answer.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I must go.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I need to return the sword... and ask him face to face.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Why are you sleeping on the walls, Miss Ling?! A Catastrophe is coming. Get down and get to a shelter.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Leave this to us.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: The Four Guardians have been deployed, as have the sand filters and Originium scrubbers. They are Yumen's first and firmest line of defense.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Given the size of the cloud formation, however, the Four Guardians will not be able to completely shut the storm out. Dust and Originium particles that get through will form a secondary storm.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: The scale would be equivalent to a small Catastrophe.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Following the evacuation, all the plates on the east side have been retracted to avoid impact, but the plates of the inner city are immobile and will be impacted by the secondary storm directly.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: How many are you?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: The Imperial Astronomical Bureau has twelve casters stationed at Yumen.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: How are you deployed?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Six here, six in the inner city.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Are six enough to protect the inner city?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: The Lord Exorcist has deemed both locations critical.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: The Imperial Astronomical Bureau will do its best.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Go to the inner city. Leave this place to me.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The danger is the same. Go.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Last time I saw a scene like this was decades ago, when I first came to Shangshu.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Yumen doesn't have brews as refined as Husong and Guixing, but Liedaozi is good stuff. Heavens, look at the scene you're treating me to.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: A toast to you too, Heaven.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Ack, there's no goblet for me to throw right now.
A crack of thunder, so close it makes everyone's heart skip a beat.
The dark clouds are above the city in an instant.
Thick masses of air pull the sky down, while the darting arc lightning looks almost alive.
Raindrops evaporate the moment they form. The air is so dry that the slightest contact could set something on fire.
Yumen serves as the flint.
A single sight as far as the eye could see. How overwhelming, how terrible, how magnificent!

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Come!
The lantern lights. The poet stands up, and drinks her fill from her flask.
The sandstorm and thunder rage, as earth and heaven become one stage.
Throw a goblet to the setting sun, toast the tower with sand overrun.
All of Heaven and earth, in the flask.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Increasing output.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Keep it up! The dams must run at maximum power.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: The sand sluices have never been asked to churn so much sand, even with Yumen at full speed. With the city stationary right now, running the sluice dams at full power without the normal offloads would result in very high wear...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: No time to think about that!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: If all the sand and Originium dust that the Wind Aegis block piles up in front, it's going to swallow Yumen's foundation, jamming the whole city.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Maybe you should worry about yourself right now.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: What the?!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: The sky is unrecognizable.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Mr. Jing? Why are you here? Everyone should have evacuated to the west side.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: I came back.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Those Shanhaizhong wangbadan are using the chaos to sabotage our Catastrophe defenses and harass the people. We caught them in the act a few times.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: That's a job for the Patrol Battalion.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Can the Patrol Battalion deal with the Catastrophe and the Shanhaizhong at the same time?

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Why do we carry swords, if all we do is hide at a time like this?

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: Hey, I help.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: You're a tourist. There's no need to...

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: Yan saying, repay drop of water with river.

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: You buy me many drink. I repay.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: I like your spirit. Alright, hop on.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: What's most important to Zuo Xuanliao? Protecting Yumen.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Catch.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Freshly brewed Liedaozi! The old man said to give you guys a treat.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Mr. Meng was...

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: No need for any of that.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: All we need to know is that he died at the hands of these wangbadan.

steps.name: Greedy Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Pah, these Yumenites didn't forget to take all their valuables, even when they're fleeing for their lives.

steps.name: Greedy Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: But there are a few jewelry shops on this street. They can't very well have taken all of it...

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: You just can't pass up a little looting, can you?

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The other team has gone to close the sand sluices. Don't forget the mission.

steps.name: Greedy Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: I would never.

steps.name: Greedy Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: But they're ready for us.

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: A bunch of ruffians who haven't had a real fight in twenty years, satisfying themselves with fighting in the ring for show.

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Useless rabble.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Here they come.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: An impressive-sounding name won't change the fact that they're just a bunch of thieves and bandits.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Useless rabble.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: They're spreading out and trying to cause as much chaos as possible. Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: I need a group to cut off Kangqing Street! It leads to the west side where the civilians are!

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: I go!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: We'll have a drink and kill some bad guys.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Why does the trip back feel so far...?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The wind and sand are getting...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Found you... good thing your footprints weren't completely wiped away.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You weren't lying about planning to come back to Yumen.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Why are you here?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: To get the sword back.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And to make sure you're safe.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Why are you hurt as well?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No time to talk about that. We need to get back to the city!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You were lucky to survive the jump down the sand sluice. Your injuries will take a long time to heal, though.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Here, hold on to me.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I must be seeing things. There couldn't be anyone else out here at a time like this.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Yumen has come to a full stop, slightly off the expected location.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: The Catastrophe has reached the eastern side of Yumen. Unable to hail Lord Wei at this time.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We're climbing.

a.text: Though the path may sever, let not thy spirit falter.
Spring chill presses armor, autumn frost dapples Yumen's barrier.
That long dream, laments ere and now.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Just look at Miss Ling.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: The excitement is rubbing off on this rat.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: They want to close the sand sluices.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: They know how important it is right now... do the Shanhaizhong have people with engineering expertise?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: (Sneers)

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: You can jump now, or I can throw your corpses down after I kill you.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Miss Qiu?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I heard Zuo Le came here, so I thought I would help out as well. Looks like I came at the right time.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Shanhaizhong once sent an invitation to the river fort of Jiangqi, but we didn't get a response.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: How ironic that you've chosen to take the side of the Yanese army.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You're well-informed.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Of course. We pay attention to those who walk our path.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Cut the crap.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Have you forgotten that you came to Yumen for revenge?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Good question. Unfortunately, I've already found the answer.
She raises her sword again.
This time, there is no need for her to pull back.
The man from Sargon swings at the Shanhaizhong member trying to attack the soldiers, forcing him back.
His Yanese is mediocre, but his attack is clean, powerful, pragmatic.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Nice!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: So you weren't exaggerating back at the inn. You've got a couple of tricks up your sleeve.

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: No couple of trick, only one trick.

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: Grandmaster taught me when he came Sargon, but only one move...

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: They're still not backing off, even after losing so many. Are they not afraid to die?

steps.name: Tourist in Sargon Garb
steps.text: What happen?

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: It's the sound of the storm impacting the Wind Aegis. Be careful.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: This is a bigger Catastrophe than any Yumen has encountered before.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: I don't even want to think about the Imperial Astronomical Bureau Casters who are taking the full brunt of it.

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The Catastrophe is raging. They have their hands full dealing with it. Don't waste time here.

steps.name: Cold Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Take these ones out and retreat to the evacuation shelters on the west side.

steps.name: Greedy Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Where do you think you're going? We knew you were coming this way.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Round them up!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: We'll leave the Catastrophe to the Imperial Astronomical Bureau Casters. These wangbadan are ours!
The sky has broken. Gravel and rock beyond reckoning clash, roll and rub against each other in the maelstrom, screeching like metal on metal.
The storm bears down on the tower, then hits a wall of Arts.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Hold your ground!

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Form up!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That's the secondary storm after it passes through the Wind Aegis?

spans.text: it passes through the Wind Aegis?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Mr. Lin! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Lending a hand.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: We can handle this. You should go back.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: To where? How am I supposed to get my afternoon nap when there's a commotion like this out here?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: The Originium scrubbers in the inner city can stop the particles from spreading, but the impact of the storm itself must be met with Originium Arts.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: One more warm body.
Lin steps forward.
He has already taken off his coat.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I've manipulated sand for decades. I might as well find a coffin to sleep in now, if I can't make myself useful at a time like this.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Or are my little tricks just a burden to the great Tianshis?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: ...Just be careful, sir.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Make way for Mr. Lin!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad! I've been looking for you...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Perfect timing, Yühsia.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're hurt!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Will that get in the way of anything?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Watch. You still have much to learn when it comes to Arts.
The storm converges again in mid-air and approaches once again. Dirt and rocks spin chaotically on the outer edge, while the air has been so compressed at the center that sparks are flying.
The heavens roar, then silence.
A wall of sand rises, filling every gap in the wall of Arts, pushing it slowly but steadily forward. One meter, three meters... ten meters.
Lin stands at the center of the casters, a great tree that budges for no storm.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: I've never seen Arts like this before...

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: To achieve such stability over such a large area...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: It's coming again!
Lin Yühsia has never seen the full extent of her father's Arts. It has never been needed for his enemies.
The shadow of Lungmen leads a regular life.
Taking 'walks' through the streets, enjoying a bowl of finball soup, visiting people, living and dead.
Most of the time, he is smiling, nonchalant. There are few things that make him bare his fangs.
He looks much smaller without his coat. Yühsia can see his arms begin to tremble, like thin branches that could be broken by a stiff wind at any time.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Help Mr. Lin down.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: He has taken the brunt of four waves of Originium storms. He can take no more.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: (Coughs blood)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad!
*pant*...
*pant*...
'I just hope this will be resolved quickly without delaying your trip to Victoria.'
'It's not your own choice if you haven't seen another path.'
Those are the kind of things that Dad always said.
Lin Yühsia did not want her father to set her path. Perhaps she has not made a decision yet.
But Dad is already old. He was not joking when he talked about retiring.
When the old fall, it is time for the young to take their place.
The logic is illogical, yet immovable.
Yühsia steps forward and takes her father's place, shielding him behind her.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Caster
steps.text: Miss Lin...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Don't speak. You're all injured. Adjust your breathing.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Here it comes.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Keep your eyes forward!
